data.title: Google DeepMind Shows Off Gemini Robotics 2 Doing Chores, and the Future Is Here - CNET
data.description: Google DeepMind released a series of videos demonstrating Gemini Robotics 2 utilizing the Apptronik Apollo 2 Humanoid Robot working alongside the Franka F3 Duo Dual-Arm System robot, and it looks like I won't be doing too many household chores in the near future.
